title: phegopteris andreana
intro: Phegopteris andreana, commonly known as the Golden Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The health benefits of Phegopteris andreana include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
